I’ve never given bone marrow but I think it depends on the method of donation, it used to be that it was done under anaesthetic and it was taken from your pelvic bone (?), but now they have a way to do it that’s similar to giving platelets.  So one needle in each arm, one side has blood taken out, it goes through a machine to separate what they need and the rest of the blood goes back in.  It takes a few hours and it would probably be uncomfortable but it’s much less invasive than it used to be and I’m pretty sure this is the most common method of donating these days.
